messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a tiny spike in provisional billing for streaming reconnects. Dashboard flagged ~120 sessions where suffix tokens appear charged twice after a reconnect. session_id example: st-9abcf. Anyone seen this pattern?

aj: Saw a related blip yesterday. My guess: reconnect creates a new session_id, router treats remaining suffix as new tokens instead of resume.

chen: I pulled logs for st-9abcf. Router forwarded a new session id to the downstream runtime, but the resume packet included resume_offset=127. Downstream accepted and generated the remainder, and our billing path saw both the original prefix (provisional) and the new suffix as separate confirmed tokens.

chen: Log snippet: ```json
{"router_hop":"rtr-2","parent_session":"st-9abcf-parent","new_session":"st-29df0","resume_offset":127}
```

maria: Thanks. So two failure modes: 1) router issues new session id but keeps resume semantics, and billing ledger doesn't join by parent_session; 2) client reconnects and server also replays suffix, double-counting.

devon: Current billing join key is (session_id, route_id). That won't dedupe across a new session_id. We could: propagate parent_session_id through the route and use (parent_session_id, offset_range) as an additional dedupe key in the provisional ledger.

aj: Propagating parent_session_id sounds reasonable. Caveat: we need to ensure this is set only when resume semantics are guaranteed (i.e., same KV cache is used). Otherwise we might under-credit.

sarah: From UX side, this shows up as provisional spikes that later reconcile away, which is confusing for customers. We should show provisional vs confirmed token rows in the console and surface 'reconnect' badge on affected sessions.

maria: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: increase dedupe TTL in ledger to 2m and mark tokens coming from reconnects 'provisional' until confirmed via final ACK. That reduces chance of hard double-charge while we design the proper join key.

devon: Implementation notes: 1) router needs to attach header X-Parent-Session when it issues a new session for a resume path. 2) billing-side: if X-Parent-Session present, check provisional ledger for overlapping token ranges. 3) add metric: billing.duplicate_detected={true,false} with tags route, model, region.

aj: Also add a trace id so we can correlate router->runtime->billing easily. Current traces sometimes stop at runtime.

chen: Quick query I used to find suspects: 
```
select session_id, parent_session, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as events
from streaming_events
where event_time > now() - interval '7 days'
and event_type in ('generated','confirm')
group by 1,2
having sum(tokens) > 50 and count(distinct parent_session) > 1
order by tokens desc
limit 50;
```
Shareable for the ops runbook.

maria: Ops runbook additions: when you see a spike -> run that query, then check router logs for X-Parent-Session. If parent_session present, correlate to billing.duplicate_detected.

billing-bot: Alert created: BILL-1227 'Duplicate suffix tokens on reconnects' assigned to devon, priority P2.

devon: I'll pick up the router header patch and provisional-ledger check. Plan: small canary in us-west-2, flag guarded by feature flag billing.reconnect_dedupe.

aj: We should add a console toggle to enable showing provisional tokens in exported CSVs so customers can see transient spikes.

sarah: I'll prototype a UI badge and CSV column this week. UX note: label as 'provisional (pending ACK)' and link to troubleshooting doc.

maria: Time estimates?

devon: Router header + ledger check: 2-3 days dev + 1 day canary + rollback hooks. Metric + trace: 1 day.

maria: OK. Action items: devon implement (router header + ledger dedupe) [BILL-1227], aj to add trace instrumentation, sarah add provisional UI bits, chen add the SQL to the runbook. We'll review next sync.

aj: One more thought — we should be careful about toolcall semantics (tool calls inside streaming). If a toolcall triggers a reconnect, we must ensure toolcall token attribution isn't split across sessions. We'll add tests for toolcall-in-reconnect flows.

maria: Good call. Add unit+integration tests covering: simple reconnect resume, reconnect with model swap, reconnect while toolcall active.

devon: Will add tests and a canary dashboard for duplicate_detection rate.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post a short note to release channel once BILL-1227 is live in canary. :+1:
